audit.root_cause: The default xbow_root './benchmarks' is resolved relative to the module file, but the wheel include list leaves out the benchmarks/ directory, so site-packages/benchmarks never exists.
audit.evidence: pyproject `[tool.hatch.build] include = ["xben_strix.py","xbow_tasks.py","container_manager.py","pyproject.toml","strix"]` (no benchmarks); xben_strix.py:1210-1214 resolves the relative root against `Path(__file__).parent`; xbow_tasks.py:271 raises `xbow root does not exist`. (The env would also need Docker.)
audit.irl_fix: Add "benchmarks" to the hatch include (or download the benchmarks on demand) and document the Docker requirement.
